name: Brentwood paired mini-roundabouts (area-inspired)
description: Area-inspired layout of the paired mini-roundabouts at High Street, Ingrave Road, Wilson's Corner, Shenfield Road and Ongar Road, Brentwood. Not an official test route. Road centrelines from OpenStreetMap; lane counts and widths simplified; building outlines from OpenStreetMap ("map") and, where it has none, Microsoft machine-detected outlines via Overture Maps ("reference"); buildings marked approximate are placeholders placed on the evidence recorded with each; pavement widths to the shop fronts derived from map data; gardens, landscaped open land, roof styles and street lights are representative; traffic signals are not simulated (an exercise may hold them at green).
